title: Renewal-Focused Account Review Decks (Starter Pack: Standard + Enterprise)
body:
Purpose and scope:
This doc contains two parallel starter decks and playbook notes meant for Customer Success Managers to run renewal-focused account reviews.
These are intentionally concise, modular, and adjustable: one deck for Standard accounts (self-serve / low-touch / SMB) and one for Enterprise accounts (multi-stakeholder, renewal negotiation). Use as slide skeletons + speaker notes + a lightweight renewal tracker CSV to copy into Sheets.

Audience and use cases:
- Standard: Customer success reps preparing 20–30 minute quarterly reviews for product-led accounts. Goal: surface ROI, surface expansion opportunities, reduce churn risk through quick next steps.
- Enterprise: CSMs + Solutions + AMs prepping 45–60 minute strategic reviews with exec sponsors and technical stakeholders. Goal: align on business outcomes, confirm roadmap fit, surface contract renewal negotiation points, create a checklist for legal/procurement readiness.

How to use this pack:
1) Pick the deck based on account tier.
2) Replace slide-level placeholders with account-specific metrics.
3) Run a 20–30 min pre-meeting sync (internal) for Enterprise accounts.
4) Capture actions in renewal tracker and assign owners immediately after meeting.

SECTION A — Standard account deck (slide-by-slide starter)
- Cover / Title (1 slide)
  Speaker note: Keep it light. Title: Account Review — <Customer Short Name> — [Quarter]. Meeting length: 25 min. CSM name + contact.
- Quick Wins / Highlights (1 slide)
  Bullets: active integrations, top features used, recent wins. Speaker note: 2–3 bullets, call out one success story.
- Engagement Snapshot (1 slide)
  Metrics to include: MAUs, top 3 feature usage (percent of users), average session length, support ticket trend (last 90 days).
  Speaker note: Visual: small sparkline chart for each metric. Say: "Usage + support trending = health indicator."
- Value Realized / Business Outcomes (1 slide)
  Template lines: "X% reduction in time-to-X", "Y cases automated", "Z monthly $ saved" — fill with customer numbers or NA.
- NPS / CSAT / Feedback (1 slide)
  Bullets: latest scores, verbatim feedback highlights, open asks.
- Renewal & Health Summary (1 slide)
  One-line recommendation: On track | At risk — recommended next steps (1–3 bullets).
- Expansion Opportunities (1 slide)
  Suggested expansion plays and minimal action items.
- Immediate Next Steps & Owners (1 slide)
  3–5 action items, owner, due date.

Timing guide: 25 min total: 3 min opening, 8 min highlights & metrics, 6 min opportunities, 5 min renewals/next steps, 3 min close.

SECTION B — Enterprise account deck (slide-by-slide starter)
- Executive cover + agenda (1 slide) Speaker note: Include meeting objective, time, and attendees (name + role).
- Strategic success summary (1 slide)
  1–2 bullets that map product usage to the customer’s strategic KPIs. Speaker note: Open with the business metric the sponsor cares about.
- Adoption & Usage deep dive (2 slides)
  Slide A: user cohorts + feature adoption curves. Slide B: performance & reliability metrics (latency, error rate, uptime) and cost-related outcomes if relevant.
- Business outcomes & ROI case (2 slides)
  Data-backed metrics showing outcome delta since adoption (ARR influence, operational savings). Include method note: "calculation assumptions".
- Risks & blockers (1 slide)
  Top 3 deployment, technical, or org blockers. For each blocker list mitigation and owner.
- Roadmap alignment (1 slide)
  Which Redwood roadmap items map to the customer’s needs; suggested priority.
- Contract / Procurement timeline (1 slide)
  Renewal window, key procurement contacts, open legal items.
- Renewal recommendation & negotiation posture (1 slide)
  Recommendation: renew-as-is | renew-with-expansion | require-commercial review. Suggested concession levers (pricing, pilot extension, success credits).
- Stakeholder commitments & RACI (1 slide)
  High level RACI table in bullets.
- Appendix / data appendix (1–3 slides)
  Deep-dive tables and query notes that can be referenced post-call.
- Action plan & escalation path (1 slide)
  Owners, deadlines, next internal check-in date.

Enterprise timing guide: 60 minutes typical: 10 min exec summary, 20 min adoption & outcomes, 10 min risks/roadmap, 10 min commercial/renewal, 10 min Q&A & next steps.

Speaker guidance and tone:
- Standard: keep prescriptive, transactional, focus on no more than 3 asks.
- Enterprise: adopt consultative tone, surface tradeoffs, prepare negotiation posture with AM.

Customization checklist (quick):
- Replace placeholders with top-3 account KPIs.
- Include a one-line customer quote or case note.
- Verify procurement/legal contacts in the Contract slide.
- Add relevant product changelog items that affect the account.
- Add a single measurable success metric to the top (so exec sees value immediately).

Renewal risk scoring (quick rubric):
- Score 0–10 (higher is better). Compute across five axes (each 0–2): usage (0–2), support sentiment (0–2), exec sponsorship (0–2), commercial health (0–2), product fit (0–2).
- 9–10: green (low risk); 6–8: yellow (monitor, account plan); <=5 red (escalate).
- Quick actions tied to bands (e.g., red => immediate exec intervention + tailored success plan).

Embedded lightweight renewal tracker (CSV to paste into Sheets) — copy/paste: 
"Account,Tier,NextRenewalDate,RiskScore,PrimarySponsor,AM,LastTouch,OpenIssues,NegotiationWindow,ActionOwner,ActionDue"
"Acme Corp,Enterprise,2024-11-30,7,Jane Doe (CIO),Samuel Park,2024-04-18,3 open items,60 days,Samuel Park,2024-05-01"
"BetaApps,Standard,2024-09-14,9,Product Lead (Tom),Maya Lin,2024-05-02,0 open items,30 days,Maya Lin,2024-05-09"

Usage notes for tracker: keep each row to the account + single renewal line. Use this table as the canonical list for 90-day renewal windows.

Suggested pre-QBR checklist (owner assignments):
- CSM: gather latest usage reports + top support tickets (2 business days before).
- Solutions/Eng (Enterprise): health check & open-blockers summary (3 business days before).
- AM/Finance (if commercial is expected): draft renewal terms baseline (5 business days before).
- Internal pre-brief (mandatory for Enterprise): 30 min sync to align negotiation posture.

Suggested post-QBR playbook (timeline):
- <48 hours: publish meeting notes, update tracker, assign actions.
- 7 days: deliverables check (technical items & SOW drafts).
- 14–30 days: pricing/legal cadence if commercial negotiation active.

Email templates (short):
- Meeting invite subject: "Account Review — <Customer> — <Quarter> (30 min)"
- Post-meeting follow-up subject: "<Customer> — Account Review Recap & Next Steps"
  Quick body bullets: thank you + 3 bullets: 1) Top outcome, 2) Confirmed actions (owner + due date), 3) Next check-in date.

Notes to self / open items (internal):
- Need canonical list of KPIs for SMB vs Enterprise to auto-populate slides (ask Analytics team).
- Test new slide templates in Google Slides; keeping slide master consistent with branding.
- Consider making a 1-slide exec summary PDF for legal/procurement decks.

Appendix: common slide snippets to copy/paste
- "Top 3 metrics" slide: show month-over-month percent change, highlight 1 KPI as source of truth.
- "Support trends" slide: list top 3 support categories + average resolution time.
- "Roadmap alignment" snippet: three bullets (Feature | Release ETA | Impact on customer).

Version history and notes:
- v0.1 (2024-02-14): initial draft, standard + enterprise skeletons.
- v0.2 (2024-03-05): added renewal rubric and tracker CSV.
- v0.3 (2024-05-03): collaborator feedback incorporated (Marco/Lena/Priya) — added procurement slide checklist.

If you're running a specific renewal that looks like a 'non-standard' case (pilot renewal, M&A, major contract restructure) — flag in tracker with tag 'special-process' and schedule a dedicated pre-brief with legal + finance.

End of document.
